summary.text: Digital birth certificates are issued only for births registered from 29 May 2022.

details.heading: Digital birth certificate
details.body: Digital birth certificates are issued only for births registered from 29 May 2022. An earlier registration at ICA does not qualify.

example_phrasings: I had earlier registered my child’s birth at ICA. Will I be issued with a digital birth certificate?
Will I get a digital birth certificate?
Does an earlier birth registration get a digital certificate?

sources.page_title: I had earlier registered my child’s birth at ICA. Will I be issued with a digital birth certificate?

quotes.text: Digital birth certificates will be issued only for births that are registered from 29 May 2022.
